e.title: NeuralForecast
e.summary: 神经时序预测库（Nixtla，4.3k★）：N-BEATS/N-HiTS/TFT——深度学习理赔预测
e.body:
NeuralForecast（Nixtla，GitHub 4.3k★+）是可扩展的神经时序预测库：N-BEATS、N-HiTS、TFT（Temporal Fusion Transformer）等深度学习预测算法。对 RIAA：时序深度学习的现代工具——理赔流量/退保/费用预测的进阶方法（同 [[statsforecast]] 的统计谱系互补）；与 [[reserving-neural]]（神经准备金）同属神经网络精算应用；预测区间/不确定性输出对接资本与预算；保险时序大数据（保单级、日频）的高容量场景。

## 同类工具

e.summary_hk: 神經時序預測庫（Nixtla，4.3k★）：N-BEATS/N-HiTS/TFT——深度學習理賠預測
e.body_en:
NeuralForecast (Nixtla, 4.3k+ GitHub stars) is a scalable neural time-series forecasting library: deep-learning algorithms such as N-BEATS, N-HiTS and TFT (Temporal Fusion Transformer). For RIAA: a modern tool for time-series deep learning — advanced methods for claims flow/lapse/expense forecasting (complementing the statistical lineage of [[statsforecast]]); with [[reserving-neural]] (neural reserving) it shares the neural-network actuarial application space; prediction intervals/uncertainty outputs feed capital and budgeting; suits high-capacity insurance time-series (policy-level, daily frequency).

## Similar tools
[[nn-freq-sev-pricing]]、[[offsetreg]]、[[openfair]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_hk:
NeuralForecast（Nixtla，GitHub 4.3k★+）是可擴展的神經時序預測庫：N-BEATS、N-HiTS、TFT（Temporal Fusion Transformer）等深度學習預測算法。對 RIAA：時序深度學習的現代工具——理賠流量/退保/費用預測的進階方法（同 [[statsforecast]] 的統計譜系互補）；與 [[reserving-neural]]（神經準備金）同屬神經網絡精算應用；預測區間/不確定性輸出對接資本與預算；保險時序大數據（保單級、日頻）的高容量場景。

## 同類工具
